北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗微凉，体感 7℃。早晚温差大，注意添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Clear and a bit cool, feels like 7℃. Mind the temperature difference!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 大雾天气，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Foggy weather, low visibility. Please be careful when traveling!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴好，体感 7℃。微凉，别忘了多穿点！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear, feels like 7℃. A bit chilly, don't forget to layer up!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州温暖宜人，体感 23℃。保持好心情，享受舒适一天！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and pleasant, feels like 23℃. Enjoy your comfortable day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 23℃。注意防晒，保持水润哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels like 23℃. Mind the sun and stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 9℃。天气微凉，记得添衣保暖！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 9℃. A bit cool, remember to dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，体感 8℃。出行注意能见度，小心慢行！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 8℃. Watch visibility, drive carefully!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 9℃。有点凉，别忘多穿一件哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 9℃. A bit cool, remember to wear an extra layer!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 11℃。注意交通安全，出行慢一点！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy, feels like 11℃. Mind traffic safety, take it slow!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 4℃。风力小但有点冷，注意保暖！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 4℃. Little wind but chilly, stay warm!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴冷，体感 -12℃。穿最厚的衣服，注意防寒！

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴冷，体感 4℃。注意防寒保暖，别冻着了！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is gloomy and cold, feels like 4℃. Dress warmly, don't get frozen!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感 12℃。昼夜温差大，别忘了添衣！

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感 2℃。风力较大，注意防风保暖哦！

大连.name: 大连
